system.description:
You can manipulate particles of punishing salt dust, corroding and dehydrating. While your Dust Veil is active, creatures that begin their turn within 15-feet of you that have less than their maximum hit points can feel the salt in their wounds as is causes severe pain forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, on a failure they choose to either lose their Reaction, or take 1d6 earth or poison damage for every rank of a condition with the [Physical] tag that they have.

| Dust Veil – Brined / [Physical], [Elemental] / A Brined creature is covered in an extremely coarse salt dust for the next minute. / If a Brined creature takes Cold damage, the salt dust hardens and crystalizes. When it does, The Brined creature is Restrained in place until the end of their next turn. This removes the Brined condition. / If a Brined creature takes Lightning damage, the salt dust becomes charged. When it does, The Brined creature gains 1 rank of Shaken each time they move 5 or more feet before the end of their next turn. This removes the Brined condition. |

Potency I: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu, they become Brined.

Potency II: Creatures that are Brined cannot regain hit points or chakra points, increases the DC of Checks to end conditions a creature has by +5 and conditions the affected creature has is now treated as if they are B-Rank, even if inflicted by a jutsu or effect of a lower rank or level as your salt blocks restoration and makes it harder to cleanse them.
